story.title: North Texas traffic stop leads to arrest of armed man accused of soliciting 15-year-old on Snapchat
story.summary: A Fate traffic stop for speeding led to the arrest of an armed 21-year-old man accused of meeting a 15-year-old girl on Snapchat for sexual activity. FATE, Texas - A routine speeding stop in North Texas led to the arrest of a 21-year-old man who police say was carrying a loaded handgun and attempting to engage in sexual activity with a 15-year-old girl he had just met on Snapchat. According to the Fate Police Department, an officer conducted the traffic stop on Nov. 19 near the intersection of Gettysburg and George Calvert, encountering the 21-year-old male driver and the 15-year-old female passenger. The driver initially told the officer he was taking his sister to the park. However, further investigation revealed the two were not related and had begun communicating on Snapchat earlier that same day.
